notes.title: Release date!!!
notes.notes:
🆕 Friends, good news! 💃🕺

🔥🔥🔥 11.06 at 8:00 a.m. PDT we launch our firstborn into the world 🔥🔥🔥

For us, this is a great day that we have been waiting for since we realized that we would finish what we started.

🔧 In connection with such news, we are temporarily closing access to the demo version for updating to the release state.

Have a nice day and see you soon✌🤘

notes.title: First demo update
notes.notes:
Hello! Today we have a big update.

List of changes:

1. Added 3 languages ​​for subtitles and interface (Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese)
2. New HUD interface
3. Added special ability of weapon 1 ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XcX2PQHbANc )
4. Minor changes for a more comfortable game

We are gradually updating unfinished places in the demo, which will also be in the release, and at the same time preparing new content that will not be included in the demo.

Nearest plans:

- New interface for tablet
- Encyclopedia of samples

We will be glad to receive feedback! Good luck!
